RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your qualifications make you a credible candidate, but the announcement doesn’t establish that you were better qualified against the actual selection criteria.

Follow up your written request. Ask for the criteria, your assessment and scores, and the reasons the successful candidate was preferred, subject to privacy rules.

Panel composition becomes relevant if applicable rules require gender balance, or other evidence suggests bias—such as sex-based comments or inconsistent assessment.

Check local review and appeal deadlines now; don’t assume your unanswered request pauses them. Two weeks’ silence alone doesn’t establish wrongdoing.
